svg.title: Review the Claude Code inspection plan and independent scientific expectations
svg.desc: 1: Check the hand calculation: unequal errors give an inverse-variance weighted mean of 3.6. 2: Review the proposed one-dimensional shape, matching-length, finite-input and positive-error validation. 3: Claude stayed in plan mode; review the written plan before allowing edits.
